  "fullResponse": "Reading the reset brief, manifest and patch.\n\nNo further reads are needed. Complete report follows.\n\nReferences are to `_build/terrain-presentation-20261017/reset-275-01/`. Inspection was read-only: file reads, hash recomputation of the thirteen manifest files, byte comparison of the founding helper against the previous recipe, and JSON summaries of the preflight capture. No command against the cluster, no test, build, edit, memory update, delegation, deployment or volume operation.\n\n## Verdict\n\nThe recipe is a faithful re-labelling of the founding procedure already used for the v11 network, pointed at image 0.7.275 and the clean08 templates, with the destructive steps gated by exact predecessor state, compare-and-set indices, retained old volumes until after fresh acceptance, and a deletion step that touches exactly the eight captured volume IDs. Scope is confined to the candidate job; main and ingress jobs are guard-only throughout. I found no confirmed defect. Two risks concern the fresh acceptance step, listed below. User authority for the data deletion is stated and I do not re-examine it.\n\n**Confirmed, by reading.**\n\n- **Scope and stale-state guards.** `prepare_refound.py:23-50` recaptures the live candidate and requires version 98, index 871075, counts eight and zero, v11 volume sources, every quod image equal to the pinned 275 digest, exactly eight ready v11 volumes with indices 0 to 7, and no v12 volume yet; it also pins main and the ingress job at version 1 index 846370. The read-only preflight from 13:36 agrees on all of these. Every later script re-asserts the captured versions and indices before acting: `create_new_volumes.py:16-21`, `bootstrap.py:41-55`, `scale_out.py:44-48`, `fleet_probe.py` and `purge_old_volumes.py` through `guard()`.\n- **Compare-and-set and single submission.** Both Nomad mutations use `-check-index` against the exact prior modify index at `bootstrap.py:62-63` and `scale_out.py:55-56`. `run_deployment.py:6` refuses to start if an `execution` directory exists, every receipt opens exclusive-create, and a non-zero child writes `STOP.json` and exits, so a lost or failed step cannot be blindly repeated. Nothing retries a write.\n- **Templates and image provenance.** `prepare_refound.py:58-80` derives the candidate job from the clean08 `deploy/quod.nomad` with twelve counted literal replacements that fail closed on any mismatch; the host volume files come from the clean08 volume template with the captured compute node IDs. `run_deployment.py:33-48` requires the clean08 twelve-gate pass with unchanged sources, the review manifest linkage, every source hash, the identical `verified-image.json` and its image source manifest from the 275 rollout, and the script manifest plus a clearance file. The founding Erlang helper is byte-identical to the previous corrected helper; the Python operator differs only in its output path.\n- **Founding profile.** `quod_fresh_systems.erl:6-18` founds each system ontology from the running image's own `/opt/quod/priv/ontologies`, so content is exactly the gated 275 source; `terms/2` at lines 174-186 founds quod:lobby with the full lobby source set including `lobby_worlds.pl` and the voxel and GUI files, and quod:signup with `human_user_instance.pl` and `gui_hud.pl` plus the signup host. The lobby dependencies at `fresh_system_operator.py:52-59` include `material_eidolons` and `environment_eidolons`, which answers the genesis-dependency risk carried since review-01 for the new network. Policies are only `ontology_creation_policy` rows and the signup hosting delegation, each idempotent and conflict-refusing. `final_gate/0` requires all eighteen ontologies ready with correct module profiles and complete enrollment before scale-out.\n- **Founding safety interlock.** The job template founds only with `bootstrap=true` and an empty `genesis_hash`, forcing count one; `bootstrap.py:57-63` passes exactly that, and `scale_out.py:49-56` passes the new root anchor with `bootstrap` left false, so the eight-node scale-out joins the fresh anchor. `run_deployment.py:56` additionally requires the new root anchor to differ from the retired one.\n- **Deadlines and observation.** Founder readiness 900 s, old allocation drain 300 s, scale-out 1200 s and deployment success 1200 s, all through indexed blocking queries without resubmission.\n- **Deletion guards.** `purge_old_volumes.py` runs only after `ACCEPTED.json` and the post-desktop fleet probe, re-checks before each delete that the candidate is at version plus two on v12 sources only, main and ingress unchanged, no old allocation running or pending and every running allocation on the new version, matches each volume's ID, name and node against the capture, deletes exactly those eight, and confirms none remain. The v12 volumes and the retired v11 set are disjoint by family name.\n\n## Risks\n\n- **Fresh acceptance may trip on the known GUI transition anomaly.** `accept_fresh.py:21-26` runs the desktop creation harness and then `walk-acceptance-04.mjs` on the created world. The walk step enters an existing world, so the creation-transition 503 and question-retirement `unavailable` seen in the meadow campaign would not occur there. The desktop harness, however, asserts an empty error list at `desktop-acceptance.mjs:187` around its own creation flow; if it collects console errors the same way, the unresolved GUI issue can fail the reset's acceptance honestly. That blocks the purge, which is the correct order, but it should be anticipated rather than read as a reset defect.\n- **No return path after bootstrap.** Once `bootstrap.py` submits the founder, the v11 network is stopped and only its volumes remain until purge. Returning to it would be a separate recovery, not a scripted rollback. This is inherent to the user's instruction and acceptable, but worth stating in the record.\n\n## Limits\n\nNo step has run; `review-clearance.json`, `refound/scope.json` and all captures beyond the read-only preflight do not exist yet. I reviewed the full current scripts but only the founding helper's creation, publication, policy, delegation and gate functions in detail, and the desktop harness only at its argument and receipt interface. Cluster state after 13:36 was not re-queried by me; `prepare_refound.py` will. Consultative, not approval.",
